thread:
alex_t: kicking off a quick sync on the litmus dashboard rollup — want to align on scope cuts for next sprint

maria_k: thanks. main asks from customers are: single-pane cost + error correlation, trace drilldown from widget, and a lightweight sampling toggle for noisy endpoints

samir: +1. we should be explicit about launch must-haves vs nice-to-haves. customers will push for full trace links but that is operationally heavy
jordan_p: can we list the launch criteria now? i'll try to map to engineering effort

emily: my proposed launch criteria: 1) cost breakdown by route (token buckets) 2) error-rate heatmap with top-10 endpoints 3) trace-link from error row -> trace view (opens in a separate tab) 4) sampling toggle UI that flips on headroom-based sampling

maria_k: +1 to those. add: basic alerts integration (pagerduty) for error spikes as a required minimal hook

samir: engineering notes: trace-link requires consistent trace IDs in our logs; we have it for new customers but older pipelines sanitize them. patching that for GA is non-trivial

alex_t: tradeoffs we discussed earlier: 1) full trace capture (heavy) vs sparse trace linking (light) 2) cost attribution accuracy vs query latency 3) retention window for heatmaps (7d vs 30d)

jordan_p: rough estimates: trace-link (light) + sampling toggle + heatmap (7d) = 2.5 dev-weeks. PD integration + route-level cost = 1.5 dev-weeks. full trace capture or 30d retention add another 2+ weeks

emily: customers in pilot explicitly asked for 30d in one case (financial infra). do we have an enterprise toggle to enable extended retention behind Dedicated/Private?

samir: yes we can gate retention on plan. default 7d for Hosted to keep cost low. Dedicated can opt-in for 30d via config. that keeps Hosted ops safe

alex_t: nice — propose we set the default GA to 7d, expose retention in advanced settings with a clear billing warning, and treat 30d as enterprise opt-in. who owns UI copy/cta for the warning?
maria_k: i'll write the initial copy and loop in legal for billing language. emily can add example screenshots for review
emily: i'll mock a small panel: cost breakdown with a sparkline, error heatmap, and a tiny "traces" link. will share by EOD tomorrow

jordan_p: quick question on sampling: do we expose percent (0-100) or named presets (low/med/high)? engineering prefers presets to avoid weird edge cases
samir: presets are easier initially. mapping: low=1%, med=5%, high=20%. we can add precise slider later if customers ask

alex_t: ok. backlog: must-haves for GA -> (A) route cost breakdown widget (B) error heatmap + top endpoints (C) trace-link (light) (D) sampling presets UI (E) PD alert hook (F) retention setting (7d default). Nice-to-have: 30d Hosted, per-team dashboards, export CSV
maria_k: can we also add rollout plan / canary criteria? propose: enable feature for 5 pilot orgs for 48h, monitor CPU and tail latency for 72h, and require <3% increase in median token latency
emily: i'll add dashboards to monitor those metrics — will include a dashboard id in the rollout doc
samir: ops checklist: ensure KV cache hit metrics are surfaced per-model and route; sampling changes must not cause KV invalidation. also need an automated fallback if trace service errors spike (>5% errors)

alex_t: decision: ship GA with the must-haves, gate 30d behind enterprise, use presets for sampling, PD hook MVP. rollout: 5 pilot orgs -> 50 orgs -> full. canary SLOs as maria suggested
maria_k: i'll update the roadmap doc and tag owners. next steps: emily mock, samir infra plan, jordan API contract for trace-link, alex coordinate pilot customers

emily: mock shared: https://mockup.redwood/in/xyz (internal) — feedback welcome :thumbsup:
samir: infra plan: add sampling flag to routing policy, ensure trace-id passthrough in serializer, add a circuit-breaker for trace-forwarding
jordan_p: API contract draft: GET /console/traces?trace_id=XYZ -> returns minimal trace metadata + deep link to full trace viewer. returning 204 if trace not found. sharing in product board

opsbot: deploybot: canary feature gate created: feature=litmus-rollup, env=staging, owners=[samir,jordan_p]

alex_t: thanks all — sync again in 48h after mocks and infra doc. any blockers call me directly. :rocket:
